destinations.name: Zhenjiang
destinations.rank_reason: Mid-size Yangtze city with three famous hills and a historic ferry quarter; worth a detour beside Nanjing/Yangzhou, not a national highlight.
destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page 'Zhenjiang' (See/Do listings: Jinshan Temple, Jiaoshan, Beigu Hill, Xijindu, Nanshan); travelchinaguide Zhenjiang attractions list.
destinations.span_reason: Ten spots within about 12 km of the centre (Vinegar Museum furthest); 30 km span gives 22.5 km.
